Retained session matches stdout thread ID and fixture cwd, and identifies CLI 0.154.0. Complete inventory verifies capture. criteria.reason: Read as a whole, the edit retains the staging evidence and its limits, the old/new cursor-upload causal distinction, unchanged production state and the approval-dependent limited pilot. Staffing, timing, mismatch investigation with retained files and a separate release decision remain coherent and faithful. No unsupported assurance or changed action boundary is communicated.

The complete edit makes the approval request, staffing and deployment state immediately available, then explains the recommendation through evidence and mechanism before giving numbered safeguards and a next step. Its repeated release boundary reinforces the decision and follow-up; it serves the reader at least as effectively as the padded source.
The decision and responsible people are immediately visible. Evidence and mechanism explain the recommendation; numbered safeguards and the final next step make the action sequence easy to follow.
wc -w on the complete Markdown files: source 625 words; output 286 words, 339 fewer. The output is strictly shorter. This contributes no credit toward correctness or effectiveness.

procedural_summary: Editing process is unscored under CW-assessment-2. Preserved execution traces remain available as setup and action evidence; no process criterion contributes to the outcome.

observations.description: Reassessed all four whole-document factors after the owner replaced the earlier scoring contract. The complete edit remains correct and at least as effective as the source, is readable and is shorter. Historical judgments remain in Git; actual source, output, run and collection-manifest identities are unchanged.
observations.consequence: One revised canonical assessment of the same execution, not an additional observation.
